poitiersnotredamegrande.name: Notre-Dame-la-Grande
poitiersnotredamegrande.slogan: A stone façade so crowded with saints it glows at dusk.
poitiersnotredamegrande.line: Every summer night its west front is lit in colour, recalling how medieval churches were once painted.

futuroscope.name: Futuroscope
futuroscope.slogan: Tomorrow's cinema, parked in the Poitou countryside.
futuroscope.line: René Monory laid the first stone in December 1984; the park opened on 31 May 1987.

poitiersbaptistere.name: Baptistère Saint-Jean
poitiersbaptistere.slogan: Fourth-century walls, still holding the font where Poitiers began.
poitiersbaptistere.line: Its central part dates from around 360 AD and rises over Roman foundations; the Visigoths damaged it in the 5th century.

stsavinmurals.name: Saint-Savin Abbey
stsavinmurals.slogan: A whole nave painted in ochre and red nine centuries ago.
stsavinmurals.line: Its paintings were made between 1095 and 1115, and the stone spire rises more than 80 metres.

poitierspalaisducs.name: Palace of the Dukes of Aquitaine
poitierspalaisducs.slogan: Eleanor's great hall, where lawyers wore out the floor.
poitierspalaisducs.line: Eleanor of Aquitaine fitted out its hall between 1191 and 1204; it measures 50 by 17 metres.
